title: Samson and Gert and the lost ball.
lines: In a happy house in Flanders live two best friends.
Gert is a young man with a friendly smile.
Samson is a big white dog with long hair.
But Samson isn't an ordinary dog.
And sometimes he says words a bit wrong.
Then he says doggy-woggy instead of doggy.
Or Gertie, I've got a little problem.
Samson and Gert don't live alone.
He's a bit strict and he always wears a smart suit.
There's also Octaaf De Bolle, the man from the shop.
And Alberto Vermicelli, the Italian hairdresser, with his funny moustache.
One sunny Saturday Gert says: Samson, today we're going to play football in the park!
He wags his tail so hard that the lamp almost falls over.
He got it for his birthday.
He catches the ball with his nose.
Until Gert gives it a really hard kick.
The ball flies high through the air.
It falls into the mayor's pond.
Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear, says Samson.
The ball is floating in the middle.
It's too far away to reach.
What are you doing at my pond?
I have a big net, he says.
But then Octaaf De Bolle comes by, with a big box of biscuits.
He leans over the pond with his arm.
He's standing up to his waist in the pond.
Samson laughs so hard that he rolls over.
Octaaf is in the pond, says Gert.
He runs to his hairdresser's and comes back with a hairdryer.
The wind blows across the water.
Samson grabs it with his mouth.
Octaaf climbs out of the pond too.
The mayor comes back with his big net.
But he sees that everything has already been sorted out.
Then I don't need this anymore.
Gert helps Octaaf pick up his biscuits.
But the ducks in the pond think they're delicious.
So the biscuits got eaten after all, he says.
Samson gives Octaaf a lick on the face.
That evening they're all sitting in the garden.
And Alberto sings an Italian song.
Samson lies with his red ball between his paws.
Gertie, he says, this was the best Saturday of the whole year.
